findings.current: I sensed a subtle change in the air.
findings.defect: The Korean specifically describes sensing a subtle change in the flow of the air. The current wording can refer to a change in atmosphere and loses that physical airflow detail, which the accepted baseline preserved.
findings.rationale: The source says “미세하게 달라진 공기의 흐름,” explicitly referring to the flow of air changing slightly.
findings.replacement: I sensed the air currents shift ever so slightly.
